caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jar set against a plain, off-white background. The jar is cylindrical with a slightly wider base and a narrower neck that expands outwards near the lip. The body of the jar is primarily a mottled gray color with hints of brown and green, giving it a textured and somewhat weathered appearance. The rim and interior of the mouth of the jar are a reddish-brown terracotta shade, with a visible chip on the rim revealing a lighter underlying color. Subtle patches of similar reddish-brown are also visible near the base and scattered across the surface, suggesting wear or exposure of the clay material beneath the glaze. The overall lighting accentuates the rounded form of the jar, creating gentle highlights and shadows that define its shape. There are no other objects or additional elements present in the composition.
title: Jam Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
